title: Small Delta, Hard Boundary: bounded browser adapter delivery

ciFast.note: The complete Fast verification workflow must pass on the exact v0.16.23 content merge before remote proof is recorded.

ciDeep.note: The release replays retained mechanical smoke evidence and hardens the delivery software contract. It does not perform the fresh B/A judgment, train a quality adapter, run the frozen held-out ruler, or claim a production browser-device matrix.

deploy.note: GitHub Pages and a cache-busted production Chromium check remain required after the exact content merge deploys.

liveProvider.note: No provider or model call is needed. The measured package is already retained, hash-bound mechanical evidence and no model-quality claim is made.

manualHuman.note: The active Scion goal declares Codex as the standing quality judge. This bounded-delivery result makes no human, instructor, independent, classroom, or multi-judge claim.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: A bounded adapter transport is necessary delivery infrastructure, not adapter-quality, held-out, paid-reference, device-matrix, or classroom evidence.

claims.summary: Browser adapter packages fail validation above 64 MiB, and GGUF browser adapters also fail above two percent of the exact 3,349,514,112-byte pinned base; the current effective ceiling is 66,990,282 bytes.

Browser adapter downloads require a stream, inspect declared lengths before opening the reader, reject overrun and truncation against exact manifest bytes, and never fall back to unchecked whole-response buffering.

Per-chunk progress is published while files remain staged, and the adapter record reaches IndexedDB only after every exact size and SHA-256 check passes; adversarial failures leave no partial registry state.

The hash-bound retained smoke package totals 52,707,007 bytes, equals 1.573572 percent of the pinned base, remains 14,283,275 bytes below the effective ceiling, and is explicitly a separate adapter without base weights.

The result is explicitly bounded to mechanical adapter delivery and creates no production adapter, quality win, held-out result, device matrix, paid-reference parity, completed B/A judgment, or human validation; public Scion remains base-only.
